nws-key-glossary / HURRICANE: intense tropical low-pressure area, sustained wind at least 74 mph (64 knots). NOAA A7 compares tropical 34/64 kt wind fields. This is a tropical-system threshold, not a claim that extratropical winds cannot be as strong.
